# WCA Lead Organizer Requirements Policy

### Version 1.0 {.version}

## Scope
The current version of this policy is only applicable to areas that are in scope for the pilot implementation of this policy, which includes Canada, Oceania, United Kingdom, and the United States.

## Purpose
This policy outlines the requirements for organizers of WCA recognised competitions to be accredited organizers by the WCA, and the process for gaining that accreditation.

## Policy
1. The Lead Organizer of a WCA competition is responsible for the competition. This includes responsibility for all organizational aspects of a given competition, including finances, venue and equipment logistics, competitor safety, management of competitors and spectators, compliance with relevant local laws, and ensuring the competition complies with the components of WCA policies and Regulations which relate to competition organization.
2. All official WCA competitions taking place solely in a country listed in the Scope section of the policy must have exactly one Lead Organizer.
   1. Exception: for multi-location competitions with location(s) in an in-scope country, each such location must have exactly one Lead Organizer. The same Lead Organizer may cover multiple locations.
3. The Lead Organizer may be an organization (e.g. a not-for-profit organization, or a limited liability company), or an individual.
4. Additional organizations or individuals may be listed as “organizers” on the WCA website for a given competition if they are volunteering or are assisting with the competition; however all requirements remain the responsibility of the Lead Organizer.
5. Individual WCA Delegates or other WCA Volunteers may be Lead Organizers. When such individuals carry out the responsibilities associated with the Lead Organizer they do so as an individual and not in the capacity of their WCA role.
6. All Lead Organizers must be accredited by the WCA. Accreditation is assigned to the organizer themselves, and is not done on an individual competition basis.
7. Lead Organizer accreditation is granted via the following process:
   1. Step 1: The Organization or Individual applies for Lead Organizer accreditation by completing the application form and providing necessary information:
      1. [Lead Organizer Application - Organization](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd5YsHGupbkjCjRobgdmSz-zAFVOxyqiI1oA9fWitcYeyj0WA/viewform?usp=header)
      2. [Lead Organizer Application - Individual](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_kDlkISTMh3mg5QZlSzqhJrBO3hXgKo3DsO4r20fPW2ec3w/viewform?usp=header)
   2. Step 2: Following step 1, the WCA Executive Assistants Team (WEAT) reviews the application details and makes a determination. This may also involve additional requests of information to be submitted by the applicant, consultation with other WCA Teams or Committees, or an endorsement of the application by a relevant WCA Delegate. Requirements for Lead Organizer accreditation include, but are not limited to:
      1. Bank account dedicated to managing all funds related to WCA activities
      2. Expense and reimbursement policy is in place
      3. Stripe (or similar payment processing tool) account in place for collecting WCA registration fees
   3. Step 3: Should the WEAT make a favourable determination in step 2, the applicant must sign or otherwise certify the Lead Organizer Accreditation Agreement in Appendix A.
8. Lead Organizer accreditation will be granted for a given country, region, or group of countries or regions, authorizing an organization or individual to act as the Lead Organizer for WCA competitions in that area only. Organizations or Individuals may apply for additional accreditations for other countries or regions.
9. Lead Organizer accreditation may be granted with conditions, which will be reflected in a modified form of the Lead Organizer agreement. Such conditions include but are not limited to: restricted use of WCA website functionality (e.g. Stripe connectivity), a specific timeframe to achieve an accreditation requirement.

## Appendix A {.page-break-before}
### Lead Organizer Accreditation Agreement

#### Purpose
This agreement outlines the agreement between the WCA and Lead Organizers that have been accredited as organizers by the WCA. This agreement is executed after an organization or an individual has been approved as a Lead Organizer, and is in effect until withdrawn or terminated by either the WCA or the Lead Organizer.

#### Lead Organizer Details

| Field               | Details                       |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Organizer type      | Organization / Individual     |
| Lead Organizer Name |                               |
| Region              |                               |
| Sub-Region          |                               |
| Approved Areas      |                               |
| Primary Contact     |                               |
| Email               |                               |

#### Agreement Details
- As a Lead Organizer, I (as an organization or individual) have responsibility for all organizational aspects of a competition I am listed as a Lead Organizer for, including finances, venue and equipment logistics, competitor safety, management of competitors and spectators, compliance with relevant local laws, and ensuring the competition complies with the components of WCA policies and regulations which relate to competition organization.
- I understand that I am responsible for all WCA dues associated with competitions I am a Lead Organizer for.
- Additional organizations or individuals may be listed as “organizers” for a given competition if they are volunteering or assisting with the competition; however all requirements remain my responsibility.
- I understand that I am only accredited as a Lead Organizer for the Region and or Sub-Region listed in this accreditation agreement.
- Any changes in my organizer status from my original application form, including a change in the leadership of my Lead Organizer organization, must be communicated to WEAT, and may require a review of my Lead Organizer accreditation.
- On an annual basis, I will provide the WCA (WEAT and WFC) a copy of bank and/or financial statements for all WCA related activities. The WCA also may request a copy of these items on an ad hoc basis for periodic review or auditing purposes.
- The WCA may require me to agree to a new version of this Lead Organizer Accreditation Agreement at a future date.
- This Lead Organizer accreditation may be withdrawn by either the WCA or the Lead Organizer.

#### Additional Conditions
None
